scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:document" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:quota" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:admin-api"
scripts.dev:gateway: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs gateway npm run dev -w doccraft-gateway
scripts.dev:auth: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs auth npm run dev -w doccraft-auth
scripts.dev:ai: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs chat npm run dev -w doccraft-ai
scripts.dev:chat: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs chat npm run dev -w doccraft-ai
scripts.dev:notification: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs notification npm run dev -w doccraft-notification
scripts.dev:document: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs document npm run dev -w doccraft-document
scripts.dev:payment: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs payment npm run dev -w doccraft-payment
scripts.dev:quota: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs quota npm run dev -w doccraft-quota
scripts.dev:analytics: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs analytics python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3017 --reload --reload-dir services/analytics/app --app-dir services/analytics --env-file services/analytics/analytics.env
scripts.dev:admin-api: node scripts/with-service-identity.cjs admin-api services/admin-api/.venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3018 --reload --reload-dir services/admin-api/app --app-dir services/admin-api --env-file services/admin-api/admin-api.env
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/wait-redis.js && concurrently "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.test:chat: node --test shared/tests/*.test.mjs && vitest run services/chat/src/services/__tests__ services/chat/src/routes/__tests__ services/chat/src/middleware/__tests__ services/gateway/src/services/__tests__/sseRelay.test.ts services/gateway/src/middleware/__tests__/chat-auth.test.ts user-frontend/src/store/__tests__ user-frontend/src/utils/__tests__ user-frontend/src/api/__tests__ user-frontend/src/components/builder/__tests__
